notes.title: Meet the Developers: Part 1
notes.content:
Greetings Brawlers!

I am your Community Manager, and I go by Hime on Discord. I want to introduce you to our development team members in the Meet the Developers series so you can learn more about what happens behind the scenes. These folks live, breathe, and dream about Quad Battle! 

[b]Hime: Hello, BZ! Please tell me about your role in the development team.[/b]
[b]BZ: [/b]Hello. I am the Producer of Quad Battle. My primary role is coordinating the daily tasks required to bring Quad Battle to life as soon as possible. I manage game development processes to ensure there are no issues and if there is one, I work to resolve it quickly. 

[b]Hime: You must have your hands because the players can’t wait for Quad Battle's official release! How do you typically start your day? [/b]
[b]BZ: [/b]I like to read up on the latest gaming industry news and trends before jumping onto the internal servers to test Quad Battle. 

[b]Hime: I joked about living and dreaming about Quad Battle, but I guess it is true!
As the producer, you oversee all game development and design. Which aspect do you think is the most important?[/b]
[b]BZ: [/b]Fair play and rich strategies. This is what our team focuses on as we create Quad Battle. 

[b]Hime: So that’s why Quad Battle’s tagline is Fast, Fair, and Fun. [/b]
[b]BZ[/b]: Yes, we hope to present Quad Battle as a unique game. We want to build a memorable game for players to enjoy, explore, and experience for years to come. 

[b]Hime: I appreciate your time talking to me. My last question is what did you learn about the beta tests that surprised you?[/b]
[b]BZ[/b]: We wanted to make wacky characters like Shark Shark, silly and outlandish, but from the players' feedback, they tend to like characters like Anubis more. 


Thank you again BZ for your time. Quad Battle is coming soon to PC so add us your Wishlist!

notes.title: Quad Battle Developer 2024 Wrap Up
notes.content:
Greetings Brawlers!

2024 was an excellent year for Quad Battle. Our unique 4v4v4v4 auto-battle multiplayer arena became a reality with the beta tests we've held. You showed us interest and provided invaluable feedback, propelling us to make Quad Battle fun and fair for all. 

So what's planned for 2025? We're glad you asked. 

We've been fine-tuning features such as game graphics and effects, optimization across Android devices, and improving the starting player experience so new players can pick up the game quickly and easily. More players, more competition, and more fun to go around!

We're also actively developing more maps, brawlers, and cosmetics to customize your experience. A couple more beta tests are planned for different regions to test changes/features, server stability, and more. This will ultimately lead to a more extensive open beta for all. Please look forward to what's new the next time you jump into the game! 

Thank you for being part of our development journey. Stay tuned and be sure to add Quad Battle to your Steam Wishlist, join our Discord server, and follow us on our social media channels if you haven't already!

Happy Holidays, and we'll see you next year!
- Quad Battle Team

《掷在四方》诚挚邀请各位玩家，欢迎进入四方乱斗的战场。在这里，您需要和队友并肩作战，开心或黑心地干掉所有对手，抢夺地盘，赢取胜利。令人高兴的是，您只需要一点脑子和操作，战术和配合往往才是胜利的关键；令人紧张的是，您还需要一点运气，因为英雄走位是Roll点决定的。四方勾心斗角，棋盘胜负随机，每场战斗都跌宕起伏，请各位乱斗家谨慎入局，小心血压。

「一键输出的爽快体验」
号称奶奶来了也能Carry的畅快玩法，没有复杂连招，锁定目标即可战斗，无需蛇皮走位，Roll点决定行动和位置，绝对公平竞技，沉浸式享受对战的快乐！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946445/1bad162c3a89921037f1b219407c77d6e4c95dba.png[/img]



「十面埋伏的刺激战场」
这是一个充满未知和危险的狩猎场，你永远不知道下一秒敌人会从哪里出现，当然，对敌人来说也一样。所以，时刻保持警惕，谨慎对待你的每一步行动，利用地形优势巧妙躲避攻击，同时为你的猎物设下陷阱，给予致命一击。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946445/c34145d6d2617160e6e0ab5699ecb2bdcc59a97b.png[/img]




「百变战术的策略配合」
偷袭！包抄！伏击！你可以和队友制定出各种各样的战术，是隐蔽前行，出其不意地袭击敌人？还是正面强攻，以用猛烈的火力压制对手？在勾心斗角的四方博弈中，精彩的策略与默契的配合，往往是杀出胜利之路的关键。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946445/8f041d52d300732174f2685c104ca1e295c44fca.png[/img]




「千人千局的无限可能」
妙趣横生的随机走位，丰富多样的角色阵容，千变万化的策略选择，让每场对战都跌宕起伏，独一无二！可能是步步为营尽在掌握之中，也可能是开局天崩被人围剿淘汰，还可能是最后时刻一鼓作气，绝地翻盘！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946445/7f533475bc03f7060dc22ea4aeb81ab00e8ff978.png[/img]




「万般精彩的开团时刻」
一个人打不过的话...那就四个人！谁还不会摇队友了！不管是主动出击，还是被动挨揍，喊上队友先打再说。四方乱斗，一触即发，小队作战，随时开黑！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946445/f264f926768bba5ce633a48715e0b66aca3bb09c.png[/img]

notes.title: The new Quad Battle playtest starts at UTC 11:00 on June 21!
notes.content:
Hi, players! The new round of testing for "Quad Battle" is coming! We will launch the New Playtest on Steam at UTC 11:00 on June 21. Here are some key details you need to know.

[h2]Q: How to participate in the test?[/h2]
A: The test version is for PC. Once the test starts on June 21, go to the Quad Battle Steam store page. At the bottom of the store page, find a green section (just below the "Add to Wishlist" button). First, click "Request Access," then click "Play Now" to join the game test.

[h2]Q: What game modes are currently available? How do you play them?[/h2]
A: The core gameplay is a 16-player battle in a 4V4V4V4 format.
Ranked Mode: 4V4V4V4 mode, available daily from UTC 4:00 to 16:00. Wins and losses affect your ranking.
Classic Mode: 4V4V4V4 mode, where wins and losses do not affect your ranking.
Room Mode: You can invite friends to join a room and play together. You can set the number of players, and games can start with fewer than 16 players.
Other Modes: More modes based on existing rules for players to explore and enjoy.

[h2]Q: What are the test details?[/h2]
A: The test starts at UTC 11:00 on June 21 and is expected to last for a week, depending on the number of participants. To enhance the gaming experience, the Ranked Mode will be available daily from UTC 4:00 to 16:00.

[h2]Q: Will there be a data wipe after this test?[/h2]
A: The game is still in early development, and we will adjust the gameplay based on feedback after each test. Therefore, all current tests will involve a data wipe. However, all characters and modes are available for free during the test.

[h2]Q: How can I provide feedback and suggestions to the developers?[/h2]
A: After the test starts, we will send out surveys via in-game mail to collect your feedback.

[h2]Q: What are the system requirements?[/h2]
A: The game currently has low system requirements, and most laptops and desktops should be able to run it.
Minimum requirements:
OS: Windows 7
Processor: Intel Core i5
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750
DirectX: Version 11
Network: Broadband Internet connection
Storage: 2 GB available space

[h2]Q: What should I do if the game gets stuck on the loading screen?[/h2]
A: Loading may take some time, so please wait a moment. If the progress bar gets stuck, wait a few minutes before restarting the client. Check if you have enough storage space. If there's still an issue, try restarting Steam and the game client. If none of these solutions work, post on Steam to let us know.

[h2]Q: What should I do if I encounter crashes, errors, or other bugs during the game?[/h2]
A: We apologize for the inconvenience. The game is still in early development, and you may encounter various bugs and issues. Most problems can be resolved by restarting the game. If the issue persists, use the bug button on the game interface to report the bug to us.

[h2]About Quad Battle[/h2]
From an idea in March 2023 to a nearly complete game now, we've spent over a year refining the gameplay to create something truly unique.

"Quad Battle" stands out with its innovative 4-way battle mode, offering dynamic matches and strategic teamwork without complex controls. Each battle feels fresh and new.

We're focusing on finishing the PC version and will soon start developing the mobile version. Our goal is to make the game cross-platform, so both PC and mobile players can enjoy it.

We'll continue to organize player tests to gather feedback and improve the game.

If you're reading this, we hope you'll join our Summer Solstice Test on June 21 and share your thoughts. Help us bring this game to life!
